title: performance difference between rootless/rootfull podman builds
body:
I had recently noticed that when running large container builds, a build that would take 10 minutes in rootless podman would take sometimes over 20 minutes in rootfull podman. Specifically rootfull would spend several minutes committing each layer when rootless would do it in seconds. After alot of troubleshooting I came across that rootfull podman is running with native overlay diff disabled.

### rootless:
```text
msg="Using graph driver overlay"
msg="[graphdriver] trying provided driver \"overlay\""
msg="Cached value indicated that overlay is supported"
msg="Cached value indicated that overlay is supported"
msg="Cached value indicated that metacopy is not being used"
msg="Cached value indicated that native-diff is usable"
msg="backingFs=btrfs, projectQuotaSupported=false, useNativeDiff=true, usingMetacopy=false"
msg="Cached value indicated that idmapped mounts for overlay are not supported"
msg="Check for idmapped mounts support "
  graphDriverName: overlay
    Native Overlay Diff: "true"
    Using metacopy: "false"
```

### rootfull:
```
msg="Using graph driver overlay"
msg="[graphdriver] trying provided driver \"overlay\""
msg="overlay: imagestore=/usr/lib/containers/storage"
msg="Cached value indicated that overlay is supported"
msg="Cached value indicated that overlay is supported"
msg="Cached value indicated that metacopy is being used"
msg="Cached value indicated that native-diff is not being used"
msg="Not using native diff for overlay, this may cause degraded performance for building images: kernel has CONFIG_OVERLAY_FS_REDIRECT_DIR enabled"
msg="backingFs=btrfs, projectQuotaSupported=false, useNativeDiff=false, usingMetacopy=true"
msg="Cached value indicated that idmapped mounts for overlay are supported"
  graphDriverName: overlay
    overlay.additionalImageStores:
    overlay.imagestore: /usr/lib/containers/storage
    overlay.mountopt: nodev,metacopy=on
    Native Overlay Diff: "false"
    Using metacopy: "true"
```

Modifying the `storage.conf` to the following resolves this issue.

```toml
[storage.options.overlay]
mountopt = "nodev,redirect_dir=off,metacopy=off"
```

However, I dont understand in depth what the trade off is for these configurations for other applications so I figured I would open an issue instead of a PR. It also just didnt make sense to me that the default configurations would be so drastically different between rootless and rootfull podman.

This may be somewhat related to #954 as I first noticed the issue shortly after the v0.69.0 release. However, it could also be an issue in older versions as well.

comments.body: with metacopy=on and redirect_dir=on, it is not enough to look at the files into an overlay directory, because some files reference files in a lower directory for their data.  This is a great optimization for running containers because operations that affect only the metadata for a file in many cases skip a copyup, but it affects building container images because we need to use the "naive diff" to see what changed

Thanks for the quick response, that helped explain what I was missing. So essentially:

Rootfull containers are able to benifit from these kernel overlayfs features, while rootless containers are not because user overlayfs requires `userxattr` to prevent containers from using those features as an escape vector.

So its less that these options degrade rootfull build performace and more that rootless containers can't use the kernel optimizations, which happens to be faster for builds.
